t: The exported PDF shows the family tree
x: Export PDF now draws the tree: the first page of the PDF is the family as it is really drawn — every box, every name, every date, every photo, the bar between a married couple and the lines down to their children.

It is the tree you are looking at, laid out by the same engine that draws the Map, with nothing folded away — and the page is turned whichever way round fits your family bigger, so the whole tree is one page and as large as it can be on it.

The two lists are still there, after the picture: the descendant tree as an indented list, then everyone A–Z with their dates. Nothing the PDF had before has been taken out, and the pages are still numbered.
If the tree cannot be drawn the PDF is what it always was — the two lists, and a line saying so instead of a blank page.
